pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Browne, 10.O-O-O Nbd7 11.Qg3
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 had g4-g5 and ...b5-b4 routes; plan 4 rerouted the c3-knight to e2, giving up d5 and e4 (reviewer). Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.notes: Plan 1 called f6 and h6 light squares; plan 2 said ...Ne5 challenges the queen (it covers f7) and called the half-open g-file open. Rewrote both plans.

pages.notes: Plan 1 had a g4-g5 route; plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with the bishop on c8 and called the half-open c-file open. Reworded both; British spelling in plan 3 (Centralise, caught by the reviewer).

pages.notes: Plan 1 had a g4-g5 route; plan 2 called queenside expansion a minority attack; plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Najdorf, Main Line, 10.Bd3 h6 11.Qh3
pages.notes: Plan 3 named White's fxg5 recapture as a move; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route. Reworded both.
